text: Store API callers span four packages. packages/analyzers/src/pipeline.ts builds a TextCache and writes the project index. packages/engine/src/project.ts reads and writes config and runs summarizeNode with the summarizer or structural analyzer. server.ts and resume.ts read the project index, and cli.ts sets attention via writeConfig. packages/core/src/ingest.ts reads and writes SourceState per session. packages/ui/mock/server.ts serves fixture index and config and calls TextCache.put. In semantic.ts, SemanticJob carries an interim flag that marks artifacts interim=true. project.ts exposes text(session, nodeId, granularity) for title, abstract or summary lookups.
